metadata.title: SDLC Operations Handover

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for securely transferring SDLC artifacts and associated trust evidence to operations without granting execution or deployment authority.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Release management, artifact promotion, operational intake, and SDLC-to-operations trust boundaries.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Solution pattern governing the SDLC-to-operations handover boundary.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines release artifacts, provenance, assurance evidence, and handover metadata as trust-relevant data.

props.name: nist-controls
props.remarks: Operations Handover implements SDLC-to-operations transition and integrity controls.

metadata.remarks: SDLC Operations Handover governs the controlled transfer of artifacts and evidence from software delivery to operations. Handover does not authorize deployment, execution, or runtime activation.

components.title: Artifact and Release Transfer
components.description: Defines the controlled transfer of SDLC artifacts, including code, scripts, infrastructure-as-code, configuration, and policy-as-code, to operational custody.

techniques.name: Modify Cloud Compute Infrastructure
techniques.remarks: Altering handover artifacts or environments during promotion to operations.

techniques.name: Artifact Verification
techniques.remarks: Verification of artifact integrity at promotion boundaries.

components.title: Provenance and Evidence Transfer
components.description: Ensures assurance results, provenance, and attribution metadata accompany artifacts into operations.

techniques.name: Subvert Trust Controls
techniques.remarks: Separating artifacts from their assurance or provenance metadata.

techniques.name: Attribution
techniques.remarks: Maintaining binding between artifacts and assurance evidence.

components.title: Handover Boundary Enforcement
components.description: Enforces clear separation between SDLC completion and operational deployment or execution.

techniques.name: Subvert Trust Controls
techniques.remarks: Treating SDLC handover as implicit permission to deploy or execute.

techniques.name: Authorization Enforcement
techniques.remarks: Explicit separation of delivery completion from operational authorization.

components.title: Operations Handover Non-Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Defines what SDLC handover does not grant or imply.
components.remarks: Successful handover does not imply authorization to deploy, execute, energize hardware, or enable therapy in OT or IoMT environments.
